identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a boat rental platform that feels like a summer breeze, not a spreadsheet.
principles: Fusion: Airbnb simplicity x Yacht Club elegance
Content: High-fidelity imagery is the hero

usage.buttons: Primary Teal for main actions, Ghost for secondary
usage.text: Slate-900 for headings, Slate-600 for body

layout.grid_system: Mobile-first 1 col, Tablet 2 cols, Desktop 4 cols (Bento style)

containers.card: rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground transition-all hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1
containers.hero: min-h-[60vh] flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden

buttons.base: h-12 px-6 rounded-full font-semibold transition-all active:scale-95

inputs.base: h-12 rounded-xl border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 focus:border-transparent

navigation.mobile: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-around items-center z-50
navigation.desktop: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b bg-background/95 backdrop-blur supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/60

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .jsx extension for all React components.
Implement a 'Mobile First' approach. The design should feel like a native app on mobile.
Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'DM Sans' for body text. Import them from Google Fonts in index.css.
Customize tailwind.config.js to add the 'Riviera Teal' (#0D9488) as the primary color.
For the Map, use 'react-leaflet'. Custom markers should be circular with the price inside.
The 'Boat Detail' page should have a sticky bottom bar on mobile for the 'Book' button.
Use the provided image URLs for demo data. Do not use placeholders.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do not use gradients for the main background. Keep it clean #F8FAFC.
Use 'lucide-react' for icons (Anchor, MapPin, Calendar, User, etc.).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
